biggest_catch: This is a targeted, nontransferable mailer offer — only the original addressee can use the promo code, and any zero balance, default, or account closure before payout forfeits the bonus.
catches: Targeted mailer: only the original addressee may participate; the promo code is nontransferable — applicants must use the code from their own mailer.
Open Simple Checking August 4–November 30, 2026 with promo code WELCOME450 and a $100 opening deposit.
Receive at least $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits in each of three consecutive statement cycles; bonus tracking starts with the second statement cycle and ends after the fourth.
Payroll, government benefits, and tax-refund ACH may qualify; teller deposits, wires, ATM deposits/transfers, card credits, external bank/brokerage transfers, and P2P payments do not.
$150 is credited on the last day of each qualifying cycle, up to $450 total — the full payout can take about 130 days.
A zero balance, default, or account closure before payout forfeits the bonus.

steps: Confirm you received the targeted Byline mailer addressed to you — only the original addressee can participate.
Open a new Simple Checking account between August 4 and November 30, 2026, using the promo code WELCOME450 from your mailer, online or in a branch.

In each of three consecutive statement cycles (tracking starts with your second statement cycle), receive at least $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits — payroll, government benefits, or tax-refund ACH. Teller deposits, wires, ATM deposits/transfers, card credits, external bank transfers, and P2P payments do not count.
Keep the account open with a positive balance through the final payout — a zero balance, default, or closure forfeits the bonus.
Receive $150 on the last day of each qualifying cycle, up to $450 total (about 130 days for the full payout).
